UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Per-user configuration for daily spending limit, lockdown mode, stealth mode, HUD theme, UPI accountability guard, Kharchee Pro membership, Night Guard, and Smart Payment Reminders.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

dailyLimit.description: Daily spending budget limit in INR.

lockdownActive.description: Whether manual or automatic spending lockdown is engaged.

autoLockdownAt90.description: Whether lockdown automatically engages at 90% daily budget usage.

stealthMode.description: Whether balances are masked in public.

themeId.description: Selected Iron Man HUD theme ID (stark, mark85, stealth).

myUpiId.description: User's personal VPA/UPI ID for group bill split deep links.

isPro.description: Whether the user has an active Kharchee Pro membership.

proTier.description: Active Pro membership tier (free, monthly, annual, sovereign).

proExpiresAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the Pro subscription renews or expires.

nightGuardEnabled.description: Whether Night Guard impulse protection is enabled.

nightGuardCooldownEndMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when mandatory 5-minute Night Guard cooldown expires.

lastChallengeId.description: ID of the last Night Guard brain diversion challenge shown.

enablePreSpendConfirm.description: Whether pre-spend confirmation dialog is shown before discretionary expenses.

notifyPaymentReminders.description: Whether scheduled payment reminder notifications are enabled.

notifyNightGuardAlert.description: Whether Night Guard activation notifications are enabled.

notifyMorningReview.description: Whether morning financial review notifications are enabled.

ExpenseRecord.title: ExpenseRecord
ExpenseRecord.description: Individual expense or income transaction logged by the user via manual entry, 1-tap preset, or SMS/UPI parser.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

category.description: Category name (Food, Chai & Snacks, Transport, Shopping, Subscriptions, Entertainment, Bills & Rent, Salary, Freelance, Refund, Investment, Other).

note.description: Optional note or parsed SMS snippet.

txEpochMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the transaction occurred.

KhataFriend.title: KhataFriend
KhataFriend.description: Friend or contact in the Khata Lena/Dena ledger for splitting bills and tracking IOUs.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

upiId.description: Friend's UPI ID for direct settlement.

netBalance.description: Positive means friend owes user (Lena); negative means user owes friend (Dena).

lastNote.description: Description of the latest split or settlement.

SavingsGoal.title: SavingsGoal
SavingsGoal.description: Micro-savings target tracked by the user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

JarvisMessage.title: JarvisMessage
JarvisMessage.description: Persistent conversation turn between the user and J.A.R.V.I.S. AI financial assistant.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

text.description: Content of the message in English, Hinglish, or Hindi.

mode.description: JARVIS personality mode active during this turn (roast, analyst,saver).

language.description: Language preference during this turn (hinglish, english, hindi).

txEpochMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the message was sent.

PaymentReminderRecord.title: PaymentReminderRecord
PaymentReminderRecord.description: Scheduled payment or bill reminder configured by the user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

dueEpochMillis.description: Due date and time in epoch milliseconds.

isPaid.description: Whether the payment has been marked as paid/completed.

NightGuardEventRecord.title: NightGuardEventRecord
NightGuardEventRecord.description: Audit record of a Night Guard impulse-spending intervention (cancelled, postponed, proceeded, or essential_bypass).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

bypassReason.description: Emergency bypass category if essential_bypass was used.

eventEpochMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the intervention occurred.

/users/{userId}.description: Root user settings document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/expenses/{expenseId}.description: Private subcollection of expenses and income entries belonging to the user.

/users/{userId}/khata_friends/{friendId}.description: Private subcollection of Khata friends and Lena/Dena balances belonging to the user.

/users/{userId}/savings_goals/{goalId}.description: Private subcollection of micro-savings goals belonging to the user.

/users/{userId}/jarvis_messages/{message.description: Private subcollection of persistent JARVIS AI conversation messages belonging to the user.

/users/{userId}/payment_reminders/{remin.description: Private subcollection of scheduled payment and bill reminders belonging to the user.

/users/{userId}/night_guard_events/{even.description: Private subcollection of Night Guard intervention events belonging to the user.
